name: The Causses and the Cévennes, Mediterranean agro-pastoral Cultural Landscape
description: This vast mountain landscape in the Massif Central of southern France, covering over 300,000 hectares, is a patchwork of high limestone plateaus and deep, narrow valleys. People have herded animals here for more than three thousand years. You can still see stone farmhouses built on terraces by medieval abbeys, and on Mont Lozère shepherds drive flocks up ancient drove roads each summer.
